criteria.requirement: This yields 17 ordered points and 16 main segments.
criteria.action: Call generate(7), inspect getState(), then repeat generate(7).
criteria.expected: Both results contain 17 identical ordered main points with fixed endpoints, zero z coordinates, and 16 main segments. (Tolerance: Coordinates within 1e-6; exact counts and deterministic equality.)

criteria.action: Inspect the live bolt LineSegments geometry after generation.
criteria.expected: The position attribute has 40 vertices representing 20 segments, ordered as main path, branch A, then branch B. (Tolerance: Exact vertex and segment counts; positions within 1e-6.)

criteria.requirement: Each crackle contributes two line segments, for 12 total.
criteria.action: Generate a strike and inspect all six crackle paths and their heights.
criteria.expected: There are six radial three-point paths, 12 segments total, every y is 0.02, and radii and alternating angular offsets follow the formulas. (Tolerance: Coordinates within 1e-6; exact counts.)

criteria.requirement: reveal `floor(20*clamp(t/400,0,1))` segments and set draw-range count to twice that number
criteria.action: Call strike(7), then step(200) and inspect the live bolt before stepping another 200 ms.
criteria.expected: At t=200 the draw-range count is 20; at t=400 it is 40, with all 20 segments revealed. (Tolerance: Exact time, segment, and draw-range counts.)

criteria.action: From a fresh strike, advance to t=600 and inspect impact scale and opacity; then advance to t=800.
criteria.expected: At t=600 all impact scale components are 8 and opacity is 1; at t=800 effects are removed, phase is idle, and impact scale is 0. (Tolerance: Scale within 1e-6; exact phase and lifecycle state.)

criteria.requirement: Invalid input must leave the current scene unchanged and display `Invalid seed`
criteria.action: After generating seed 7, submit invalid seed text and then activate Reset.
criteria.expected: Invalid submission preserves scene state and shows the message; reset removes effects, restores seed 0 and initial simulation state, and preserves camera and grid. (Tolerance: Exact state and message; camera transforms within 1e-6.)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
